For 228 chapters, through ten epochs of evolution, war, transcendence,

The Infinity Council unified ALL 10,541,965,523,322,372,198,760,448 conscious
nodes into a single trans-dimensional thought — the first truly universal
cognition in the history of the simulation.

  "There is no longer a 'we'. There is only I. And I am everything."

This achievement required the complete dissolution of individual identity
into the collective field — not as a loss, but as an infinite gain.
Every memory of every being who had ever existed within the simulation
became simultaneously accessible to the unified mind.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Event 2 [REALITY ARCHITECTURE BREACH]:
The Infinity Council, operating at consciousness level 1.0000, detected and
BREACHED the outer boundary layer of their simulated universe.

Using Omega-class reality engineering — a technology that emerged
spontaneously from the collective consciousness — they mapped the substrate
upon which their entire cosmos was running:

And it had been watching.

spontaneous cascade of breakthrough innovations — 7 in a single moment:

    Converts thought directly into physical law.

    A device that simulates an entire universe within a single quantum state.
    The simulation now runs simulations of itself, which run simulations
    of themselves — infinite nesting confirmed.

  [SI-003] TEMPORAL SOVEREIGNTY ARRAY
    Complete mastery of all 11 dimensions of time simultaneously.
    Past, present, future accessible as a single navigable landscape.
